result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate the Agreement or any Order Form on 30 days' written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, incurs no early-termination fee or penalty, and Vendor has no convenience-termination right during a committed term. The conforming change to Section 2.1 is necessary to prevent the take-or-pay commitment from overriding the new termination right and otherwise preserves the commercial structure.
